desc: Electronics Mart India Limited informed the exchange regarding the Board meeting held for the (i) Approval of Annual Report, and (ii) Calling the 08th AGM of the Company along with Approval of the Notice of AGM.

Electronics Mart India Limited has informed the exchange about the newspaper advertisement published on 31st August 2026 with respect to the scheduling of the 08th Annual General Meeting of the Company.

Electronics Mart India Limited has informed the exchange about the copy of the newspaper publication published on 02nd September 2026, regarding the dispatch of the Notice of the 08th Annual General Meeting and E-voting details.

Pursuant to Reg 30(6) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform that the Company officials will be attending the investor conference scheduled to be held on 10th September 2026 at Grand Hyatt, Mumbai.
